name: command-centre
description: A local-first personal productivity command centre for macOS.

scripts.dev: npm run build:preload && concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/electron/main/main.js file:dist-electron/preload/preload.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:preload && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:preload && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
